integrity: The general maximal Hilbert-distance value and abstract uniqueness are acknowledged prior mathematics; this report claims only the explicit optimizing metric and sharp semicircle threshold. The mathematical proof is analytic; finite checks are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Specific to complex two-dimensional arc spaces and Hermitian Hilbertian comparison norms. No near-optimal stability or higher-dimensional classification. The 2026 motivating preprint abstract was inspected but its complete text was unavailable; potential implicit coverage of the optimizer remains a literature risk.
title: The unique optimal Hilbertian metric for circular-arc function planes freezes at a semicircle
